newsitem.title: USA: Lucille gets acquisition bid from Suprema.
newsitem.headline: Lucille gets acquisition bid from Suprema.

text.p: Lucille Farms Inc said Thursday that it has received a non-binding offer from cheese manufacturer Suprema Specialties Inc to purchase all of its outstanding stock for $2.50 per share.
Lucille Farms said its directors will consider the offer later this month, and informed Suprema that it does not intend to comply with its two day deadline to respond to the offer.
The company also said it has asked Suprema to show that it is capable of financing an all cash offer, since it believes that Suprema does not have such capability.
Lucille Farms was up 1/2 at 2 in afternoon trade on Thursday. Suprema was off 1/8 at 4.
